scripts.build:lsp: cargo build --release -p doc-lsp && mkdir -p editors/vscode/bin && cp target/release/doc-lsp editors/vscode/bin/
scripts.build:vsix: pnpm run build:lsp && pnpm run build:vscode && pnpm --dir editors/vscode exec vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository -o ../../butterfly-dream.vsix
scripts.install:vscode: pnpm run build:vsix && cursor --install-extension ./butterfly-dream.vsix --force && echo 'Reload Cursor window (Cmd+Shift+P → Developer: Reload Window) to pick up the extension.'
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:lsp && pnpm run build:vscode
